title: Pasteur-Paris University International doctoral program (PPU)
about: International PhD program at Institut Pasteur with Paris universities: about 15 openings a year, three-year contracts. The call for October 2027 enrolment runs October 1 to November 16, 2026; results by mid-February.
requirements: Master's degree completed by the summer before enrolment (not required at the deadline)
Candidates are first chosen by host labs, then reviewed by a selection committee
Shortlisted candidates interviewed in early February

upskill.name: AI Foundations Academy
why: Field "Biomedical and life sciences" -> A001.21 objectives "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support" and "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold)" (closest match, score 4.7 < course_min_score 6, so the Academy page is linked rather than the course)
